title: Hero
description: Editorial split-grid hero — eyebrow pill, large serif headline, italic pull-quote, two-button CTA row, right-column portrait card with optional caption. Fully props-driven (no SITE_CONFIG hardcode); pass title/quote/ctas/image as props. Lifted 2026-05-16 from rahmanef.com and sanitized: replaced consumer Heading/Section primitives with raw semantic elements + tracking-widest fallback so the slice works on any Tailwind setup.
